summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for static queue size selection in two-queue cache systems. It addresses parameter initialization for staged-queue algorithms (e.g., S3-FIFO, 2Q) with specific workflow (characterize → baseline → validate → assess → adjust → deploy). No existing skill covers this semantic capability. Peer candidates (trace filtering, demotion efficiency assessment, demotion speed/precision measurement) are complementary analysis skills at different stages, not overlapping. Existing skills are unrelated (Flink DataStream sinks). Candidate has clear constraints, cautions, and support evidence from cache literature (ARC/2Q reference). Should be persisted as new capability.
